fields.amenities.0.title: Wifi
fields.amenities.1.body:
Two remotes: the large one for the TV, the small one to navigate the Android box.

Apps already installed: Netflix, YouTube, SFR TV. You can also cast from your phone (AirPlay / Chromecast).

Remember to log out of your accounts before you leave.
fields.amenities.1.title: Television
fields.amenities.2.body:
Wall radiators can be adjusted individually. Ideally 19-21°C in winter.

Sensors cut off heating if a window stays open too long — remember to close it properly.
fields.amenities.2.title: Heating
fields.amenities.3.body:
Touch ceramic hob: press the controls to adjust power from 1 to 9.

Child lock: long press on the lock button.
fields.amenities.3.title: Hob
fields.amenities.4.body:
Nespresso machine in the kitchen.

We provide coffee capsules and tea for your first night, to help you settle in. After that, capsules are available for purchase at the supermarket just downstairs.
fields.amenities.4.title: Nespresso Coffee
fields.amenities.5.body:
Sheets are in the cupboard to the right of the TV.

To unfold: remove the cushions, pull the strap under the seat then unfold the mattress.
fields.amenities.5.title: Sofa bed
fields.amenities.6.sub: Household linen provided · dishwasher also available
fields.amenities.6.title: Washing machine
fields.amenities.7.body:
To get started — coffee capsules and tea (first night), 2 to 3 rolls of toilet paper for your stay, one dishwasher tablet.

For your entire stay — sheets and towels, shower gel, shampoo and soap, hairdryer, iron.

Everything you need is here to start well; for a longer stay, everything is just a short walk away.
fields.amenities.7.title: What we provide
fields.amenities.8.body:
The bin room is at the bottom of the stairs, in the interior courtyard.

Please take out your rubbish when you leave — out of respect for the cleaning team.
fields.amenities.8.title: Bins & recycling

fields.arrival.keybox_help.checks.2: After several wrong codes, the box goes into safety mode. Wait 1 to 2 minutes without touching it, then try again calmly.

fields.parking.text.0: The building is in a pedestrian zone: no parking in front of the door.
fields.parking.text.1: Unloading luggage at the foot of the building is possible when the bollards are open (often in the morning) — but it's not guaranteed. Plan to carry your luggage a few hundred metres.
fields.parking.text.2: Robelin and Battant car parks are free, 5 min walk away. Cusenier Beaux-Arts is paid, 7 min away.
fields.recos.food.0.desc: Art Deco brasserie from 1850, 700 m away. The setting alone is worth the trip — booking recommended.
fields.recos.food.1.desc: All the cheese specialities of Franche-Comté (a historic region): fondue, cancoillotte, tartiflette.
fields.recos.food.2.desc: Contemporary bistro, seasonal menu with Asian influences. Great vegetarian options.
fields.recos.food.3.desc: Chef Francesco di Marzio's table, overlooking the Doubs and Micaud park. For a special dinner.
fields.recos.shop.0.desc: Right next to the building — organic, fresh, local.
fields.recos.shop.1.desc: Several addresses in the district: bread, pastries, coffee to go.
fields.recos.shop.2.desc: Several pharmacies in the immediate area. On-call pharmacy posted in the window.
fields.recos.visit.0.desc: Vauban's UNESCO-listed masterpiece, 2 km away. Three museums and a museum with aquarium.
fields.recos.visit.1.desc: In the splendid Renaissance Palais Granvelle — the history of Besançon watchmaking.
fields.recos.visit.2.desc: Lunch or dinner cruise with commentary on the Doubs, lock passages and tunnel under the Citadel.
fields.recos.visit.3.desc: At Saint-Jean Cathedral. Mechanism with over 30,000 parts (1858-1860).
fields.recos.visit.4.desc: Birthplace of the writer, 140 Grande Rue. Contemporary and moving scenography.
fields.recos.visit.5.desc: Open-air ecomuseum in Nancray: traditional Franche-Comté habitat. Perfect for a half-day.
